Chapter II – Accounts

A. Basic accounts

4. The bank shall open a basic account subject to the limits in paragraph 5 and the identity checks in paragraphs 6 and 7.1

5. A basic account has these limits:

(1) credits in a year do not exceed ₹1,00,000;

(2) the balance does not exceed ₹50,000 at any time.

6. Identity is verified using an OVD as defined in clause (i) of paragraph 3.

7. Video verification may replace a branch visit.
